desc.dungeontidbits.room_key: Obtained through cat gifts, hero of the village gifts, and wandering trader trades. Can be used on Room Gateways.
desc.dungeontidbits.pottle_sherd: Can occasionally be found in Trail Ruins through archeology, alternatively obtained through completed Room Spawners.
desc.dungeontidbits.effect_extract: Created and used by Pottles. Variation mostly depends on the flowers available to you.
effect.dungeontidbits.suspicious_effect: Perhaps you can use those flowers...
desc.dungeontidbits.pottle: A combination of pots and kettles. Creates a small effect cloud from contained Effect Extracts when powered by redstone.
desc.dungeontidbits.room_gateway: Can be found in rare-ish buried structures themed after itself. Replaces all blocks within its structure when a Room Key is used.
desc.dungeontidbits.room_spawner: Created by Room Gateways. When it is clicked on, it will try to lower your defense and melee damage with a flash and then summon a wave of mobs.
